content.comment_body: Hello, I have a question about how to insert parameters into the message area, specifically related to adding <Time Base>. The time base can be set to hours, minutes, seconds, or milliseconds. When inserting a time base parameter from a function block in the message area, its slot uses seven cells. Afterwards, if you try to add another parameter, such as <Current time>, you cannot partially overlap the new parameter with the previous one. As a result, there will be six empty cells between Current time and Time Base (or five free cells if milliseconds are used as the time base). A screenshot is attached for reference. Any guidance would be appreciated. Regards,

The main issue is that the [product_name] display aligns analog values to the left. Additionally, your scenario with the stopwatch is a special case. The current time is shown not in time format but as a number based on the selected time base. For example, 2 minutes 30 seconds is displayed as 90 when seconds are chosen as the time base, rather than 02:30. You can try using the 'Scale time' function. See the attached file.

analysis.insight_summary: Users face difficulties with parameter placement and spacing in the message area of the [product_name] display. The system manages cell space inefficiently, resulting in unused cells and limited options for arranging parameters. Additionally, the time values shown are not formatted in a conventional, user-friendly way, which leads to confusion and dissatisfaction when trying to interpret the displayed information.
analysis.user_expectations: Users expect to be able to insert several parameters without unnecessary empty spaces and want control over alignment and positioning. They also anticipate time data to be shown in a clear, familiar format such as 'hh:mm:ss', rather than in unconventional units like raw seconds.
